resolution: Editor OOM-crashed at ~1.4GB ('Ineffective mark-compacts near heap limit') on cold start of a grass-heavy map. Diagnosed: the flora PREVIEW (render3d/GrassField FoliageField) builds the whole grass/palm field in JS unconditionally when mounted — up to MAX_INSTANCES=1,048,576 blades × STRIDE-12 floats plus 200k+ palm fronds — and GameWorld3D gates that build on showFlora=floraVisible, which cold-starts to true (twig state resets on restart). So every dev launch materialises the million-row field BEFORE rendering and exhausts the heap, which is exactly why the user sees no grass yet the editor still dies. Unblock: defaulted floraVisible to false in IsoAuthor.tsx (hot-reloadable, does NOT touch the other session's in-flight grassPopulation.ts); toggle 'Fl' re-enables it. Left uncommitted because IsoAuthor is tangled with the other session's prop/flora refactor. Awaiting the user's restart to confirm the OOM clears; if it persists with flora off, the hog is the ~512MB command-stream flush instead. Durable fix = the flora refactor's lightweight shader preview (no million JS rows).
